verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so always-on scheduled or triggered agents are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence only shows interactive, per-chat agent sessions (git and PR work, a permissions toggle). Nothing documents schedules, triggers, background or always-on operation, or autonomous maintenance runs. The full-permissions toggle is an adjacent control and does not deliver recurring or triggered autonomy.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously
